classification.habitat: Coastal scrub, thickets and dry tropical areas
classification.distribution: Tropical Asia and coastal regions; found in India

identification.description: Armed scrambling plant with bipinnate leaves, yellow flowers and hard grey-brown seeds enclosed in prickly pods.
identification.whole_plant: Prickly, woody climber or scrambling shrub.
identification.stem: Young stems armed with stout recurved prickles.
identification.leaf: Bipinnate leaves with numerous small leaflets.
identification.flower: Yellow flowers in racemose or panicle-like inflorescences.
identification.fruit: Inflated or oblong prickly pod containing hard seeds.
identification.seed: Large, hard, rounded to ovoid grey-brown seeds.
identification.bark: Young woody stems have prickles; mature bark becomes rough.

therapeutics.precautions: Do not interpret historical fever terminology as a modern diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

phytochemistry.chemical_notes: Exact composition depends on seed preparation; no quantitative assay asserted.

modern_information.evidence_summary: Latakaranja is a traditional medicinal plant; modern evidence should be interpreted separately from classical indications.
modern_information.safety_notes: Hard seeds and prickles require careful handling; verify identity before use.
